history.insight: A tree data structure for storing intervals or segments, allowing querying range sum/min/max and point/range updates in O(log n) time.
Divides the search interval in half repeatedly on sorted collections, running in logarithmic time O(log n). Always watch out for integer overflow: use mid = low + (high - low) // 2.
A tree-like data structure used for efficient retrieval of keys in a dataset of strings, ideal for autocomplete and spell-checkers with O(L) lookup where L is word length.
Finds the single-source shortest path in weighted graphs with non-negative edges using a min-heap in O((V + E) log V) time.
Hash maps achieve average O(1) time complexity by mapping keys to bucket indices using a hash function. Collision resolution commonly uses chaining or open addressing (linear/quadratic probing).
